summary: Package fetches and executes remote JavaScript from mutable Bitbucket URL
details: The package consists of a minimal HTML wrapper (index.html) whose only behavior is to fetch content from a hardcoded, unpinned URL at https://bitbucket.org/p2p-alt-public/p2p-emis/raw/main/GameWebSight, parse the returned HTML, and re-create every <script> element from the response as a live script tag in the host document, causing the fetched JavaScript to execute in the consuming page's origin. The 'raw/main/...' reference is a mutable branch with no commit pin, no hash check, and no signature verification, so the Bitbucket account 'p2p-alt-public' can substitute arbitrary code at any time. package.json has an empty author field and a generic 'Website loader for remote HTML content' description, and main points directly at the wrapper HTML.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
